note: Holding exercises raise BP during the hold: left out at BP {reading}.
Vigorous exercise left out at BP {reading}: moderate effort only.
At BP {reading}: walking-type, balance, breathing and gentle mobility only.
BP {reading} is 180/110 or above: no exercise plan; a doctor decides.
Vigorous exercise left out at sugar {reading}: moderate effort only.
Sugar {reading} is 300 mg/dL or above: no exercise plan; a doctor decides.
Sugar {reading} is below 70 mg/dL (low sugar): no exercise plan; a doctor decides.
Hb {reading} (anaemia): vigorous exercise left out; keep the effort easy.
Hb {reading} is below 8 g/dL: no exercise plan; a doctor decides.
Vigorous exercise left out at SpO2 {reading}.
SpO2 {reading} is below 92%: no exercise plan; a doctor decides.
Resting pulse {reading} is fast: vigorous exercise left out.
Resting pulse {reading} is 120/min or above: no exercise plan; a doctor decides.
Resting pulse {reading} is slow: vigorous exercise left out (check for BP medicines such as beta-blockers).
Resting pulse {reading} is below 40/min: no exercise plan; a doctor decides.
